field_definitions.name: Created By
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The name of the user who created this object. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.
field_definitions.description: The name of the user who created this object. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.

field_definitions.name: Creation Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The date and time this object was created. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.
field_definitions.description: The date and time this object was created. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.

field_definitions.name: Description
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to enter or edit a description of this object.
field_definitions.description: Use to enter or edit a description of this object.

field_definitions.name: Last Modification Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The most recent date and time this object was changed. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.
field_definitions.description: The most recent date and time this object was changed. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.

field_definitions.name: Last Modified By
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The name of the last user who edited this object. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.
field_definitions.description: The name of the last user who edited this object. It is set by the application and cannot be edited.

field_definitions.name: Location
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The path of this object within this object hierarchy. It cannot be edited after it is created.
field_definitions.description: The path of this object within this object hierarchy. It cannot be edited after it is created.

field_definitions.name: Name
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The name of this object.
field_definitions.description: The name of this object.

field_definitions.name: Orphan
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Indicates Direct if an object has no parents, and Indirect if the object has one or more parents but all parent paths contain a Direct orphan.
field_definitions.description: Displays the orphan status of the object.

field_definitions.name: Title
field_definitions.localized_guidance: The title of this object.
field_definitions.description: The title of this object.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Actual Completion Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to record the date when the work on this action item was actually completed.
field_definitions.description: Use to record the date when the work on this action item was actually completed.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Additional Description
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to enter or edit additional information about this action item.
field_definitions.description: Use to enter or edit additional information about this action item.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Approve Reject
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to approve action item
field_definitions.description: Use to approve action item

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Assignee
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to assign a person ownership or responsibility for this action item.
field_definitions.description: Use to assign a person ownership or responsibility for this action item.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Due Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to indicate the date after which this issue action item is overdue.
field_definitions.description: Use to indicate the date after which this issue action item is overdue.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Expected Completion Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to set the expected completion date for this action item.
field_definitions.description: Use to set the expected completion date for this action item.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Issue Owner for Approval
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to capture the name of the expected approver for the closure of the action. If blank, this will be inherited from the parent issue.
field_definitions.description: Use to capture the name of the expected approver for the closure of the action. If blank, this will be inherited from the parent issue.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Percent Complete
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to indicate the progress of this action item.  Enter a numeric value between 0 and 100.
field_definitions.description: Use to indicate the progress of this action item.  Enter a numeric value between 0 and 100.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Start Date
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Use to record the date when the work on this action item started.
field_definitions.description: Use to record the date when the work on this action item started.

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Status
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Updated automatically by the system upon Submission for Approval and Acceptance Closure
field_definitions.description: Updated automatically by the system upon Submission for Approval and Acceptance Closure

field_definitions.name: OPSS-AI:Submit for Approval
field_definitions.localized_guidance: Saving the Action with this field set to Yes will update the Status to Awating Approval
field_definitions.description: Saving the Action with this field set to Yes will update the Status to Awating Approval
